judged_text: In credential-sync mode refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response, but the ZohoCRM caller immediately evaluates zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error, which only exists on an axios response object. With credential sharing enabled, a ZohoCRM token refresh throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading error)' because a fetch Response has no .data property, crashing the ZohoCRM calendar service.

record.issue_text: [BUG] In credential-sync mode refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response, but the ZohoCRM caller immediately evaluates zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error, which only exists on an axios response object. With credential sharing enabled, a ZohoCRM token refresh throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading error)' because a fetch Response has no .data property, crashing the ZohoCRM calendar service.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `refreshOAuthTokens` which, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId`, returns the result of `fetch(...)` (a Fetch `Response`) instead of the original client response shape (e.g., axios). In `packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh path was changed to `const zohoCrmTokenInfo = await refreshOAuthTokens(async () => await axios(...), "zohocrm", credential.userId);` and immediately dereferences `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error`. If the credential-sync branch is taken, `zohoCrmTokenInfo` will be a Fetch `Response` without a `.data` property, so `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data` is `undefined` and accessing `.error` will throw, matching the finding.
